Geometry_and_Silhouette: Three-wheeled human-powered vehicle with one front wheel and two rear wheels.
Front wheel has handlebars for steering.
Overall length is notably compact, roughly the size of a small child's bicycle.
Functional_Components: Seat is a molded plastic saddle positioned above the rear axle.
Pedals connect directly to the front wheel hub via crank arms.
Rear wheels are smaller than the front.
Material_and_Context: Frame is steel tubing painted in bright colors.
Some models have a basket mounted on the handlebars or rear.
Chain guard covers the drivetrain on adult models.

Geometry_and_Silhouette: Fast sailing vessel with three parallel hulls: a central main hull and two smaller outrigger hulls.
Main hull is slender and pointed at both ends, remarkably elongated relative to its narrow beam.
Outrigger hulls are positioned at a considerable distance to each side, creating a wide and stable stance.
Functional_Components: Mast rises from the center of the main hull with a large triangular mainsail and jib.
Deck is flat and open between the hulls.
Rigging lines run along the deck.
Material_and_Context: Hulls are fiberglass or aluminum in white.
Crossbeams connect the main hull to the outrigger hulls.
The wide stance provides exceptional stability at high speeds.

Geometry_and_Silhouette: Three-legged support device with legs extending from a central hub.
Each leg is adjustable in length via telescoping sections.
Height ranges from compact tabletop size to well above standing eye level at full extension.
Functional_Components: Top features a mounting platform with a pan-tilt head and a screw for attaching cameras.
Spread angle is adjustable via a center column or individual leg locks.
Rubber or spiked feet at the leg ends.
Material_and_Context: Legs are aluminum or carbon fiber in black or silver.
Carrying handle on the center column.
Locking clamps or twist locks secure the telescoping sections.

Geometry_and_Silhouette: Monumental arched gateway structure constructed from stone, marble, or concrete.
Central archway is tall with a semicircular or pointed opening.
Some have multiple archways with one large central and two smaller side arches.
Functional_Components: Flanking columns or pilasters frame the arch.
Decorative reliefs and sculptural panels adorn the facade.
Top features an entablature with inscriptions.
Material_and_Context: Surface is smooth stone with carved details.
Color is white, cream, or weathered gray.
Positioned at the end of a grand avenue or in a public square.

Geometry_and_Silhouette: Electric passenger bus drawing power from overhead wires via two trolley poles.
Body is a long rectangular box of substantial length with large windows along both sides.
Roof-mounted trolley poles have carbon collector shoes.
Functional_Components: Entrance doors are at the front and/or middle.
Interior has rows of seats and standing poles.
Front has a large windshield and destination sign.
Material_and_Context: Exterior is painted in transit authority colors with route numbers displayed.
No exhaust pipe indicating zero emissions.
Wheels are standard rubber tires on city streets.

Geometry_and_Silhouette: Brass wind instrument with a long cylindrical tube bent into an elongated S-shape.
Distinctive U-shaped slide mechanism allows the player to vary the tube length.
Bell flares outward at the end, notably wide and pronounced.
Functional_Components: Mouthpiece is a cup-shaped brass piece inserted into the leadpipe.
Slide is made from two parallel tubes with inner and outer slides.
Water key visible on the bell section.
Material_and_Context: Surface is polished brass, gold brass, or silver-plated with a mirror-like reflective finish.
Overall length is remarkably extended when the slide is fully pulled out.
Brass wind instrument.

Geometry_and_Silhouette: Large open container with a wide circular or oval shape and vertical or slightly tapered sides.
Diameter is generously wide relative to its depth, with a broad open mouth.
Rim is rolled or reinforced for strength.
Functional_Components: Some tubs have handles on opposite sides.
Interior may have measurement markings.
Used for holding liquids, bathing, or storage.
Material_and_Context: Material is wood with metal bands, galvanized steel, plastic, or ceramic.
Surface shows wear, scratches, or patina from use.
Wooden tubs show stave construction with metal hoops.

Geometry_and_Silhouette: Access control gate consisting of a central vertical post with three or four rotating horizontal arms.
Arms are metal tubes extending a moderate radial distance, just enough to allow single-file passage.
Full-height turnstiles have a cage-like structure with vertical bars reaching well above head height.
Functional_Components: Rotation is ratcheted to allow one person per push.
Base is bolted to the floor.
Some models have an electronic card reader or coin slot integrated into the post.
Material_and_Context: Color is typically silver, black, or painted to match the facility.
Directional arrows indicate the flow of traffic.
Access control gate for entry points.

Geometry_and_Silhouette: Mechanical keyboard with rows of round or square keys arranged in a QWERTY layout.
Each key has a raised letter, number, or symbol printed on top.
Overall width is compact, fitting comfortably on a desk surface.
Functional_Components: Key travel is deep with a tactile mechanical click.
Space bar spans the bottom row with shift keys on either side.
Carriage return lever is on the left side.
Material_and_Context: Frame is metal painted black or gray.
Keys show wear on frequently used characters.
Typebars strike an inked ribbon from below.

Geometry_and_Silhouette: Handheld collapsible canopy mounted on a central shaft with radiating ribs.
When open, diameter is generously wide, easily spanning the width of a person's shoulders.
Collapsible models fold down to a compact length via a telescoping shaft.
Functional_Components: Canopy is fabric stretched over several metal or fiberglass ribs.
Shaft is metal or wood with a curved or straight handle.
Opening mechanism is manual or automatic button-activated.
Material_and_Context: Canopy colors range from solid black to vibrant patterns.
Tip of each rib has a small protective cap.
Ribs converge at a runner that slides along the shaft.
